mechanism: Generic types, conditional types, mapped types, `infer`. All erased. This is where TS is deeper than Java generics — and where compile times go to die.
why: JS APIs are extremely higher-order; a Java-style generic system could not type lodash/React.
useWhen: Typed libraries, React components, API SDKs.
price: Turing-complete types; unreadable error messages; nothing executes.
